about.intro: I’m a software engineer with 7+ years of experience and a soft spot for frontend. I like building apps that are easy to use and writing code that’s easy to maintain. I also work on APIs, backend services and deployments.
about.values: I like teams where we can ask questions, bounce ideas around and learn from each other.
about.mountains: Away from the keyboard, I’m usually thinking about mountains

build.intro: I mostly work with React and TypeScript, and like working through technical decisions with the team.

projects.intro: Cinema in classrooms, XR media and school newsrooms.
projects.description: A few projects I’ve worked on, and what I did on each.

cined.subtitle: European cinema in classrooms
cined.description: I worked on CinEd for several years, adding features, adapting it for more languages and migrating users from the old platform. It helps bring films into classrooms and is used by 3,000+ people across 12+ countries.
cined.alt: CinEd film education platform shown in layered screen views

xreco.subtitle: Tools for working with XR media
xreco.description: I was the main developer on XReco’s core web app. My work covered media uploads, multimodal search, AI-generated metadata, 3D reconstruction and licensing workflows.
xreco.alt: XReco media discovery platform shown across layered screens

true.subtitle: A newsroom for every school
true.description: On TRUE, I worked as a full-stack developer and technical coordinator, building editorial tools, dashboards and publishing workflows for students and teachers in 200+ Portuguese schools.
true.alt: TRUE school newsroom and publishing platform shown in layered screens
